credits.title: Fight Against Evil 3
credits.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.

credits.title: Malice
credits.overview: Journalist Ye Pan is looking for the truth behind a puzzling double fall. During her investigation, she reports nurse Li Yue and mother You Xi as suspects, which triggers public outcry and the situation gradually gets out of control.

credits.title: Keep Rolling
credits.overview: A tense situation unfolds when a leader accidentally steps on a live landmine. As time runs short, people must decide between helping, alerting authorities, or shifting blame knowing their choices affect everyone's survival.

credits.title: I Love You to the Moon and Back
credits.overview: Newlyweds Lin Xiushan and Wang Rui, living apart due to work, seize a holiday for a loving journey by train where they meet diverse passengers and discover love's true meaning before night falls, yearning to make their dreams come true.

credits.title: One and Only
credits.overview: After getting recruited by a veteran street dancer, an aspiring breakdancer will do whatever it takes to prove he can make his way to the top.
